Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: The various designations are listed in descending order of formality: _____ "A" features a midnight blue coat with standing collar
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: The various designations are listed in descending order of formality: Blue Dress "A" features a midnight blue coat with standing collar.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: The enlisted version includes seven gilt buttons and red trim and is worn with a white web belt, while officers wear a five-button coat that omits the red trim which is worn with a black _____ belt
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: The enlisted version includes seven gilt buttons and red trim and is worn with a white web belt, while officers wear a five-button coat that omits the red trim which is worn with a black Sam Browne belt.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: Officers wear a plain, collarless, white button up shirt with or without _____ cuffs
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: Officers wear a plain, collarless, white button up shirt with or without French cuffs.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: Full-sized medals are worn on the left chest, with ribbon-only awards worn on the right, but _____ are not worn
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: Full-sized medals are worn on the left chest, with ribbon-only awards worn on the right, but Marksmanship Qualification Badges are not worn.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: Because the _____ uniform is considered formal wear, Blue Dress "C" and "D" are rarely worn
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: Blue Dress "C" is the same as "B", but a khaki long sleeve collared shirt and tie replace the outer blue coat and white gloves. Blue Dress "D" is the same as "C", but with a khaki short sleeve shirt and no tie.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: The main exceptions are Marine recruiters and _____, who wear the "C" and "D" in warm weather, and Marine One pilots in place of a flight suit
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: The main exceptions are Marine recruiters and Marine Security Guards, who wear the "C" and "D" in warm weather, and Marine One pilots in place of a flight suit.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: Only the "B", "C", and "D" _____ uniforms are authorized for leave and liberty wear; the "A" is not
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: Blue Dress "D" is the same as "C", but with a khaki short sleeve shirt and no tie. Because the Blue Dress uniform is considered formal wear, Blue Dress "C" and "D" are rarely worn.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: Prior to _____, the "Blue-White" dress uniform was authorized to be worn for the ceremonial units at Marine Barracks, Washington, D.C
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: Prior to 1998, the "Blue-White" dress uniform was authorized to be worn for the ceremonial units at Marine Barracks, Washington, D.C.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: (most famously the Silent Drill Platoon and _____)
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.answer: United States Marine Corps Color Guard
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: (most famously the Silent Drill Platoon and United States Marine Corps Color Guard).

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: This uniform replaced, in _____, an all-white uniform, similar in appearance to that of the Navy officer's white dress uniform
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: This uniform replaced, in 2000, an all-white uniform, similar in appearance to that of the Navy officer's white dress uniform.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: Like the Blue-_____ uniform, musicians are not authorized to wear the khaki shirts with the Red-Dress uniform
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: This uniform replaced, in 2000, an all-white uniform, similar in appearance to that of the Navy officer's white dress uniform. Like the Blue-White Dress uniform, musicians are not authorized to wear the khaki shirts with the Red-Dress uniform.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: Should the condition warrant (e.g., summer heat), the band will wear a white shirt with the _____ uniform trousers
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: Today members of the ten Marine Corps field bands wear the standard Blue Dress uniforms, while the members of the United States Marine Band (The President's Own) and the United States Marine Drum and Bugle Corps (The Commandant's Own), both based in Washington, D.C., carry on this tradition by wearing the Red Dress uniform, which features a scarlet blouse with blue trim. Should the condition warrant (e.g., summer heat), the band will wear a white shirt with the Blue Dress uniform trousers.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: It comes in three varieties: _____ dress "A" For male officers, it consists of an evening coat with sleeve ornamentation, strip collar, white waistcoat, and white shirt with piqué bib
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: It comes in three varieties: Evening dress "A" For male officers, it consists of an evening coat with sleeve ornamentation, strip collar, white waistcoat, and white shirt with piqué bib.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: SNCO _____ staff non-commissioned officers wear a semi-formfitting mess jacket with a black bow tie and sky blue trousers
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: SNCO Evening Dress Male staff non-commissioned officers wear a semi-formfitting mess jacket with a black bow tie and sky blue trousers.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: Female SNCOs wear identically the same _____ as female officers, minus the sleeve ornamentation and placement of rank
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: Evening dress "B" is identical to Evening Dress "A" except men wear a scarlet waistcoat (general officers) or cummerbund (all other officers), and women may wear a short skirt. SNCO Evening Dress Male staff non-commissioned officers wear a semi-formfitting mess jacket with a black bow tie and sky blue trousers.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: Junior officers not required to possess _____ may substitute Blue or Blue-White dress "A"
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: Junior officers not required to possess Evening Dress may substitute Blue or Blue-White dress "A".

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: The present service uniform of the USMC for enlisted Marines was adopted in _____ making it the oldest service uniform still in use by the United States armed forces
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: The present service uniform of the USMC for enlisted Marines was adopted in 1943 making it the oldest service uniform still in use by the United States armed forces.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: visiting the _____, except when in a tourist capacity, or on an occasion where another uniform is specified
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: visiting the White House, except when in a tourist capacity, or on an occasion where another uniform is specified.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: reporting for duty onshore Like the _____ uniform, the service uniform is authorized for wear while on leave or liberty
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: reporting for duty onshore Like the Blue Dress uniform, the service uniform is authorized for wear while on leave or liberty.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: The service uniforms are designated: _____ "A" (or Alpha) is the base uniform
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: reporting for duty onshore Like the Blue Dress uniform, the service uniform is authorized for wear while on leave or liberty. The service uniforms are designated: Service "A" (or Alpha) is the base uniform.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: Service "B" (or _____) is identical to the "A" except the coat is removed
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: Service "B" (or Bravo) is identical to the "A" except the coat is removed.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: Service "C" (or _____) is identical to the "B" except with a short-sleeve button-up shirt and no tie
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: Service "C" (or Charlie) is identical to the "B" except with a short-sleeve button-up shirt and no tie.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: However, in late _____, the Commandant of the Marine Corps approved the Marine Corps Uniform Board's recommendation to adopt the male dress and service cap as the universal dress and service cap for a
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: However, in late 2013, the Commandant of the Marine Corps approved the Marine Corps Uniform Board's recommendation to adopt the male dress and service cap as the universal dress and service cap for all Marines, male and female.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: As on the _____ uniform, officers wear rank insignia on the shoulder epaulettes of their jackets and the collars of their shirts, while enlisted personnel wear rank insignia sewn on their sleeves
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: As on the Blue Dress uniform, officers wear rank insignia on the shoulder epaulettes of their jackets and the collars of their shirts, while enlisted personnel wear rank insignia sewn on their sleeves.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: A green crewneck sweater (originally adopted from _____ and Royal Marines issue) in the same color shade as that of the trousers may be worn with the "B" and "C" uniforms
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: A green crewneck sweater (originally adopted from British Army and Royal Marines issue) in the same color shade as that of the trousers may be worn with the "B" and "C" uniforms.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: Previously, _____ wore the same utility uniforms as the Army
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: A green crewneck sweater (originally adopted from British Army and Royal Marines issue) in the same color shade as that of the trousers may be worn with the "B" and "C" uniforms. Previously, Marines wore the same utility uniforms as the Army.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: The uniform uses _____ digital camouflage patterns, of which there are two approved varieties
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: The uniform uses MARPAT digital camouflage patterns, of which there are two approved varieties.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: Both officers and enlisted _____ wear pin-on rank insignia on each collar point
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: Both officers and enlisted Marines wear pin-on rank insignia on each collar point. The variety worn depends on the environment; deployed Marines wear whichever color is more appropriate to the climate and terrain.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: The variety worn depends on the environment; deployed _____ wear whichever color is more appropriate to the climate and terrain
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: Both officers and enlisted Marines wear pin-on rank insignia on each collar point. The variety worn depends on the environment; deployed Marines wear whichever color is more appropriate to the climate and terrain.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: The desert _____ is only worn in appropriate field environments
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: The desert MCCUU is only worn in appropriate field environments.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: In the past, when _____ wore the same utilities as the Army and Air Force, this served to distinguish them from the other branches, who folded the sleeves in with the camo facing out
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: The variety worn depends on the environment; deployed Marines wear whichever color is more appropriate to the climate and terrain. During the summer months, Marines in garrison will roll the sleeves of the woodland blouse, tightly folded up to the biceps, exposing the lighter inside layer, and forming a neat cuff to present a crisper appearance to the otherwise formless uniform.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: Marines in a combat area may also wear _____, or FROG uniforms
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: Marines in a combat area may also wear Flame Resistant Organizational Gear, or FROG uniforms.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: These combat uniforms are designed to reduce fire-related injuries, and look quite similar to the _____
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: These combat uniforms are designed to reduce fire-related injuries, and look quite similar to the MCCUU.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: It was unveiled during a tour of Iraq in December _____ by former Commandant of the Marine Corps General James Conway, and was released in February 2008
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: It was unveiled during a tour of Iraq in December 2007 by former Commandant of the Marine Corps General James Conway, and was released in February 2008.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: In addition, _____ can wear a watch cap and gloves in cold weather, or a hydration pack to prevent dehydration
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: In addition, Marines can wear a watch cap and gloves in cold weather, or a hydration pack to prevent dehydration.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: Grey tanker jacket is authorized with the Dress "C" and "D" and _____ "B" and "C" except when the all-weather coat is worn
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: Grey tanker jacket is authorized with the Dress "C" and "D" and Service "B" and "C" except when the all-weather coat is worn. Green service sweater may be worn with the MCCUU (but only with and under the blouse).

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: Gloves may be worn at the individual's discretion except when uniformity is required such as in a formation ceremony (white for Dress, black for _____, black or olive green for Utilities)
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: Grey tanker jacket is authorized with the Dress "C" and "D" and Service "B" and "C" except when the all-weather coat is worn. Green service sweater may be worn with the MCCUU (but only with and under the blouse).

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: Green service sweater may be worn with the _____ (but only with and under the blouse)
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: Green service sweater may be worn with the MCCUU (but only with and under the blouse). Olive green undershirt with a unit insignia or other design may be worn in lieu of a plain olive green undershirt for the MCCUU or with the PT uniform (a custom shirt will not be mandatory unless provided without cost to the individual).

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: Female Marines may wear the _____ or Utility maternity uniforms when the standard items will no longer fit
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: Gloves may be worn at the individual's discretion except when uniformity is required such as in a formation ceremony (white for Dress, black for Service, black or olive green for Utilities). Purses may be worn or carried by females only, while umbrellas can be used by both males and females (when appropriate in dress or service uniforms) and must be black and plain.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: There is no maternity dress uniform, while the maternity _____ comes in both woodland and desert patterns
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: Olive green undershirt with a unit insignia or other design may be worn in lieu of a plain olive green undershirt for the MCCUU or with the PT uniform (a custom shirt will not be mandatory unless provided without cost to the individual). There is no maternity dress uniform, while the maternity MCCUU comes in both woodland and desert patterns.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: Various organizational clothing items may be worn with the utility uniform during inclement or cold weather, to include the _____ (APECS) parka and trousers, the Combat Desert Jacket, or rain poncho
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: Various organizational clothing items may be worn with the utility uniform during inclement or cold weather, to include the All Purpose Environmental Clothing System (APECS) parka and trousers, the Combat Desert Jacket, or rain poncho.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: This is usually seen by instructors at schools or conferences, by recruiters, and by drill instructors or _____ advisors
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: This is usually seen by instructors at schools or conferences, by recruiters, and by drill instructors or NROTC advisors.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: Primary Marksmanship Coaches wear the _____ fiber helmet with the utility uniforms
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: Primary Marksmanship Coaches wear the American fiber helmet with the utility uniforms.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: One of the most notable adornments is the Eagle, Globe, and _____, found in some manner on most uniforms; it is even within the MARPAT digital camouflage pattern
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: One of the most notable adornments is the Eagle, Globe, and Anchor, found in some manner on most uniforms; it is even within the MARPAT digital camouflage pattern. An older insignia, progenitor to the Eagle, Globe, and Anchor can be seen in modern dress and service coat buttons.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: An older insignia, progenitor to the Eagle, Globe, and _____ can be seen in modern dress and service coat buttons
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: One of the most notable adornments is the Eagle, Globe, and Anchor, found in some manner on most uniforms; it is even within the MARPAT digital camouflage pattern. An older insignia, progenitor to the Eagle, Globe, and Anchor can be seen in modern dress and service coat buttons.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: The "blood stripe" is found on the outside seams of the dress uniform trousers of _____, SNCOs, and officers
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: The "blood stripe" is found on the outside seams of the dress uniform trousers of NCOs, SNCOs, and officers.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: Tradition holds that it represents the high casualty rates of those leaders during the Battle of _____
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: Tradition holds that it represents the high casualty rates of those leaders during the Battle of Chapultepec.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: Officers wearing the _____ uniform also have additional gold trim on the trouser stripe
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: Officers wearing the Evening Dress uniform also have additional gold trim on the trouser stripe.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: Musicians in the _____ replace the crossed rifle in their insignia with lyres to denote their non-combat role
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: Musicians in the United States Marine Band replace the crossed rifle in their insignia with lyres to denote their non-combat role.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subSubject: Uniforms of the United States Marine Corps

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: Large medals are authorized only on the Dress "A" uniform, while awards for which no medal was struck will have ribbons mounted on the opposite pocket. Miniature medals are worn on the Evening Dress uniform, and are authorized for wear with civilian tuxedos when appropriate to the event.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.subject: Food Processing

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: Miniature medals are worn on the _____ uniform, and are authorized for wear with civilian tuxedos when appropriate to the event
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: Miniature medals are worn on the Evening Dress uniform, and are authorized for wear with civilian tuxedos when appropriate to the event.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.question: The buttons on the dress and service coats are reminiscent of Marine insignia prior to the adoption of the Eagle, Globe, and _____
Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: The buttons on the dress and service coats are reminiscent of Marine insignia prior to the adoption of the Eagle, Globe, and Anchor.

Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: Enlisted Marines wear service stripes on the cuff of the dress and service coats, each stripe denoting four years of service as a Marine. Uniforms of the United States Marine Cor.fact: During ceremonies, officers have the option of wearing a Sam Browne belt and the Mameluke sword, and Noncommissioned Officers may wear the NCO sword.
